title: The Compass of Patagonia's dry side
author: A. M. Thackeray
blurb: Wendell Whitlock, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
